name: Create Key Event
description: Creates a new key event. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/config/admin/v1/rest/v1beta/properties.keyEvents/create)

configurable_props.name: parent
configurable_props.label: Property
configurable_props.description: The resource name of the parent property where this Key Event will be created. Format: `properties/123`

configurable_props.name: eventName
configurable_props.label: Event Name
configurable_props.description: Immutable. The event name for this key event. Examples: `click`, `purchase`

configurable_props.name: countingMethod
configurable_props.label: Counting Method
configurable_props.description: The method by which Key Events will be counted across multiple events within a session.

options.label: Each Event instance is considered a Key Event.
An Event instance is considered a Key Event at most once per session per user.
